go: used to talk about the future
to happen in a certain way; to become
大有帮助 (go a long way)
the words of a song or story say

to become, or make something be in a state
使（某人）做 (get sb. to do)

到达；抵达 (get to / get close to)

used in phrases with special meanings
make: to cause someone or something to be or do something
（与名词搭配）作出 (make a call / a discovery / a mistake)
to do the action named by the noun
to check that something is true or will happen
more: used to make the comparative of long adjectives and adverbs
time: the passing of minutes, hours, days etc.
次；回 (the first time / several times)
及时 (in time)；随着时间推移 (over time)
so: used to start or continue a talk
well: in a good or satisfactory way
也；和…一样 (as well / as well as)
used when you pause or start speaking
（比较级 better / 最高级 best）更好；最好
take: to look after someone or something
to use a train, bus etc. to travel
to need a certain amount of time
to get hold of something, or move it
to study a course; to write notes
work: to do a job, especially for money
to be successful or have the effect you want
to spend time making or improving something
to develop in a good way
a job, or the things you do in it
see: to visit a place or person
to be the time or place when something happens
just: used to make a word stronger
know: to be familiar with a person or place
day: the time when it is light; your daily life
at some time in the future
help: to make something easier for someone
use: to do something with a tool, method or thing
come: to move towards the speaker or a place
to have something as its origin
to start to feel or think something over time
（问题等）出现 (come up)；想出 (come up with)
to happen; to think of an idea
look: to turn your eyes towards something
to feel happy about something that will happen
to look at the things around you
think: to have an opinion or belief
to have something in your mind
the way you use your mind
find: to have a feeling or opinion about something
to learn something from a study
want: to wish to have or do something
school: a place where children or students study
home: to or at the place where you live
way: a method or manner of doing something
路；路途 (on the way / all the way)
a road or route, or the distance
used to add a new topic
give: （与名词搭配）作出 (give advice / attention / a call)
to do the action named by the noun
last: 上一个的；最近的 (last year / last time)
only: used to show a disappointing result
place: a position or a chance to join
book: to arrange to have a seat or room
feel: to have a feeling or emotion
to seem in a certain way
to experience through touch or the senses
